scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nextide/ui && npm run build --workspace playground
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @nextide/ui && npm run dev --workspace playground
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings && npm run lint --workspaces && npm run security:watchlist
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @nextide/ui && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
